verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes a structured API reference with endpoint-level pages such as send-calls and create-api-key. A live OpenAPI spec is served at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json, which could drive an interactive reference. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-browser 'try it' playground or runnable request examples. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
